subject: why Grace waits for the next packet only until a deadline before decoding with the packets it has

groups.why_chosen: Grace's receiver waits for a still-missing packet only until a computed deadline t*, because waiting past that point yields lower utility than decoding immediately with the packets already in hand.
groups.what_to_learn: a decaying sawtooth curve annotated with speech-bubble callouts marking a threshold that splits a favourable from an unfavourable outcome
